# Arguments: zin_arg_value (number).
zin_noris_add_accord = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_noris_accord_set } }
		set_country_flag = zin_noris_accord_set
		set_variable = { zin_noris_clan_accord = 45 }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_noris_clans }
	}
	add_to_variable = { zin_noris_clan_accord = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_noris_clan_accord min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { zin_noris_accord_stab = zin_noris_clan_accord }
	subtract_from_variable = { zin_noris_accord_stab = 50 }
	divide_variable = { zin_noris_accord_stab = 500 }
	set_variable = { zin_noris_accord_cons = zin_noris_clan_accord }
	subtract_from_variable = { zin_noris_accord_cons = 50 }
	divide_variable = { zin_noris_accord_cons = 1000 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

zin_noris_monthly = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0 }
	zin_noris_add_accord = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = zin_noris_tent_moot_spirit
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.2 }
		zin_noris_add_accord = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = zin_noris_throne_of_furvior_spirit
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.1 }
		zin_noris_add_accord = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_east_in_crisis
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.3 }
		zin_noris_add_accord = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_east_charters > 2 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.1 }
		zin_noris_add_accord = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_east_charters > 3 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.1 }
		zin_noris_add_accord = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_east_charters > 4 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.1 }
		zin_noris_add_accord = yes
	}
	set_variable = { zin_noris_rivalry = global.zin_east_rivalry }
	set_variable = { zin_noris_rift_holder = global.zin_east_road_rift }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_noris_clan_accord < 21 } }
		random = {
			chance = 17
			country_event = { id = zin_noris.20 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_noris_clan_accord > 79 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_noris_accord_high_seen }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_noris_accord_high_seen
		country_event = { id = zin_noris.21 }
	}
}

zin_noris_sweep = {

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_mode = 1 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_east_is_south_court = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = ROOT.zin_noris_sweep_value }
			zin_east_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_mode = 2 } }
		every_other_country = {
			limit = {
				is_in_faction_with = ROOT
				zin_east_is_court = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = ROOT.zin_noris_sweep_value }
			zin_east_add_lean = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_mode = 3 } }
		every_other_country = {
			limit = { is_in_faction_with = ROOT }
			add_political_power = 25
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = zin_noris_gift_goodwill }
			ROOT = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_noris_gift_goodwill } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_mode = 4 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_character = zin_noris_tumo }
			character:zin_noris_tumo = { add_skill_level = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_mode = 5 } }
		every_owned_state = { clr_state_flag = zin_noris_marched }
		random_owned_state = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = zin_noris_marched }
				any_neighbor_state = { OWNER = { zin_is_stabilo = yes } }
			}
			set_state_flag = zin_noris_marched
			add_building_construction = {
				type = bunker
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
				province = { all_provinces = yes limit_to_border = yes }
			}
		}
		random_owned_state = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = zin_noris_marched }
				any_neighbor_state = { OWNER = { zin_is_stabilo = yes } }
			}
			set_state_flag = zin_noris_marched

				type = bunker

			}

			limit = {

				any_neighbor_state = { OWNER = { zin_is_stabilo = yes } }
			}
			set_state_flag = zin_noris_marched
			add_building_construction = {
				type = bunker
				level = 1
				instant_build = yes
				province = { all_provinces = yes limit_to_border = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_mode = 6 } }
		set_variable = { zin_noris_rift_best = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_region_magical_lands
				any_enemy_country = { has_country_flag = zin_east_coalition_member }
			}
			set_variable = { zin_noris_rift_count = 0 }
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { zin_is_site_rift_west = yes }
				OWNER = { add_to_variable = { zin_noris_rift_count = 1 } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_noris_rift_count > ROOT.zin_noris_rift_best } }
				ROOT = { set_variable = { zin_noris_rift_best = PREV.zin_noris_rift_count } }
				save_global_event_target_as = zin_noris_rift_target
			}

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_noris_rift_best > 0 }

						zin_is_site_road_rift = yes

						zin_is_site_road_sand = yes

			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_noris_free_count > ROOT.zin_noris_free_best } }

# Arguments: zin_arg_who (country), zin_arg_modifier (1-based position in the opinion_modifiers block), zin_arg_both (1 for both ways).
zin_noris_opinion = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 1 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_noris_pilgrim_tax
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_noris_pilgrim_tax
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 2 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_noris_pilgrim_welcome
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_noris_pilgrim_welcome
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 3 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_noris_treaty_renewed
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_noris_treaty_renewed
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 4 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_noris_gift_goodwill
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_noris_gift_goodwill
			}
		}
	}
}
